component-o.description-s: Single-channel adjustable constant-current linear LED driver for an 850 nm IR illuminator: high-side output Q, 4.5-42 V supply, up to 500 mA, PWM/enable input, open-load status output, WSON-8 4x4 (DRJ). I(Q) = V(REF) / R(REF), V(REF) = 177 mV typ (168-185 mV).

non-technical-o.lifecycle-source-s: DigiKey API: Active (2026-10-21); TI package addendum 10-Nov-2025: Active

cfgpins-ao.4c: R(REF) from REF to GND, the LED cathode returns to REF (p.10 Figure 6; layout p.12: route REF directly to R(REF)). I(Q) = V(REF)/R(REF), V(REF) = 177 mV typ, 168-185 mV (p.5 table 6.5, eq. 5 p.9, valid for R(REF) 0.39-10 ohm, p.4 table 6.3). 9.31 ohm gives 19.0 mA typ, 18.0-19.9 mA over V(REF) spread, under the 100F5T-IR-FS-850NM 20 mA rating; 8.87 ohm would give 20.0 mA typ but 20.9 mA max. Dissipation in R(REF) 3.4 mW (0603 fine). For a 100 mA IR emitter use 1.78 ohm; 0.39 ohm is the 454 mA ceiling.

cfgpins-ao.1c: PWM / enable input, driven by the hub GPIO (ds-ir_led-rx). High (>= 2.6 V, p.4) = on, low (<= 0.7 V) = sleep, 0.1 uA typ off current (p.4, Table 1 p.8). Needs a 3.3 V or 5 V GPIO: a 1.8 V GPIO does not reach V(PWM,H). Input sinks 220-500 uA at 5 V (p.4). The 100k pull-down is not in the datasheet: I(PWM,L) is only +/-1 uA (p.4), so a floating GPIO during hub boot could light the illuminator; the pull-down holds it off. Datasheet: if PWM is unused connect it to I (p.3).

cfgpins-ao.2c: Open-collector open-load status output (p.3, 7.3.2 p.7): goes low after the D delay when the R(REF) drop falls below 25 mV typ (15-40 mV thresholds, p.5). Datasheet asks for a pull-up >= 4.7 k (p.3); Figure 6 uses 10 k to the microcontroller rail (p.10). Not wired in the default camera head: left open (an open-collector output with no pull-up draws nothing). If the hub wants open-LED diagnosis, wire ST to a hub GPIO input with 10k to that GPIO's IO rail (ST max 16 V recommended, p.4) - do not pull it to RAW_5V if the GPIO is not 5 V tolerant.

cfgpins-ao.5c: Status delay capacitor to GND: t(STHL) = 10 ms per 47 nF (p.5, Figure 5 p.8, max 2.2 uF p.4). Left open: 'If no delay is needed, leave open' (p.3); status is unused here.

cfgpins-ao.9c: Exposed thermal pad: solder to the PCB; 'may be connected to ground or left floating' (p.3); tied to GND with vias for heat spreading (p.12).

led-driver-o.iset-s: R(REF) REF to GND (LED cathode on REF): I = 177 mV / R(REF), R(REF) 0.39-10 ohm

specs-o.pwm-freq-s: NOT STATED: the datasheet gives no PWM frequency range; turn-on/off delay 15 us typ, 40 us max (p.5) bound the shortest usable PWM pulse
specs-o.protection-s: short-circuit proof, reverse-polarity proof (supply -42 V abs), open-load detection (p.1, p.3)
specs-o.iout_accuracy_note-s: I = V(REF)/R(REF), V(REF) 168-185 mV (p.5, 6.5): 9.31 ohm gives 18.0-19.9 mA for the 20 mA IR LED; R(REF) 0.39-10 ohm is the allowed range (p.4), but the output-current accuracy figure is specified only for 177-454 mA

step_source-o.derived-s: upper bound: the operating max 22 mA (p4); the datasheet states no idle or low-power current for this rail
